question: During the nationwide “Seva Parv” campaign held from September 17 to October 2, 2025, which state pledged to plant 15 lakh saplings to promote environmental sustainability?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The state of **Uttar Pradesh** pledged to plant **15 lakh saplings** during the nationwide **“Seva Parv”** (also known as **Seva Pakhwada**) campaign held in **2025**.
 
• The **Seva Parv** campaign is an annual event observed from **September 17**, which marks the **birthday of Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, to **October 2**, the birth anniversary of **Mahatma Gandhi**.
 
• The initiative in **Uttar Pradesh** was designed to promote **environmental sustainability** and align with the national goals of increasing **green cover** across the **Indian** landscape.
 
• The drive emphasized the participation of various departments, including the **Environment, Forest and Climate Change Department** of the state, ensuring that the **15 lakh saplings** were planted in strategic locations suc
